provenance.notes: DocuSeal's API reference states no rate limit nor quota, for its cloud (api.docuseal.com, api.docuseal.eu) or an instance of one's own: limits unknown. A self-hosted instance (AGPL-3.0 software) has no provider in between: whoever runs it sets its limits, and a site declares them as its tightening. On DocuSeal's cloud the terms of service and the plan decide commercial use, storage and redistribution; they were not read here: unknown.
